50120402.text: Wake up! You gotta wake up!

50120405.text: Oh no... were we too late?

50120406.text: Aaah! No... Don't come any closer!

50120407.text: It's okay, sweetie, they're not monsters... I think they're here to help.

50120412.text: The Abyss had us surrounded... Luckily, these Fatui came to our rescue, and we started evacuating.

50120413.text: But then that black fire shot out of the stadium, and that huge monstrosity appeared in the sky... Right after that, monsters suddenly appeared everywhere.

50120414.text: They couldn't fight them off, so... so they hid us here...

50120416.text: You should keep moving. This is no place to hang around.

50120417.text: Right, you need to get to the stadium. C'mon, we'll take you.

50120418.text: Thank you... You saved our lives. We're forever indebted to you.

50120424.text: Y—Yeah... Paimon knows, it's just... it hasn't fully sunk in yet...

50120425.text: But anyway, right now, let's focus on getting them to the Stadium.

50120426.text: With any luck, there'll be an update waiting for us there. If not... we'll just have to play things by ear.

50120502.text: A bitter war lies ahead. Our victory begins in each of your minds... So ignite the spirit of victory for me.

50120503.text: May no further lives be lost, and no one else made to suffer the loss of their loved ones.

50120504.text: "As long as blood still runs through your veins, even the tiniest spark of steel against stone can ignite a flame."

50120505.text: "Its blaze will become one with the gaze of all Natlan."

50120506.text: "Even amid everlasting darkness, our bonds remain eternal."

50120509.text: "For flames born anew, and the blazing dawn."

50120510.text: "A hero scaled the volcano to seize the sun."

50120511.text: "Anointed with flames, she shone with the light of a thousand stars."

50120512.text: "Now, guide me in my first step."

50120513.text: "Having foretold his own death, the omniscient man holds a feast in celebration."

50120514.text: "Let us raise our cups in honor of his heroism and send him off with this final tribute."

50120515.text: "For, at last, his wish is now fulfilled."

50120516.text: "By past fuel, and present flame, life marches ever on."

50120517.text: "We will answer to the fire for all our deeds."

50120518.text: "My life's suffering shall be my epitaph."

50120519.text: "To remember the pain I endured, and finally, transcended."

50120520.text: Heroes of the ages, our moment has finally come.

50120603.text: Wait, y—you're... What happened to the monsters?

50120605.text: All of them? But there were so many...

50120606.text: What's the situation here? Any other survivors?

50120609.text: The warriors protecting our group all fought to their deaths. We weren't about to sit around waiting to die, so we snuck out and made a run for it. But we didn't get far before the monsters spotted us...

50120610.text: Who knows, maybe we should've stayed put after all.

50120611.text: Ugh, when I was in my prime, I could have handled them all by myself... *cough* ... *sigh*

50120612.text: You need to get out of here, now.

50120613.text: Yeah. Take our hot air balloon and head to the stadium.

50120614.text: Oh... But won't that hold you up, if we take it?

50120615.text: What the...? How is anyone still here!? I thought the monsters had captured this place?

50120618.text: Yes, of course! Leave them with us.

50120620.text: What's the matter? We need to go! It's not safe here.

50120621.text: It's just... I can't help but think things might have turned out differently if only I'd chosen to fend for myself sooner, rather than expecting other people to protect me...

50120622.text: It's not too late — maybe even for me. I might be an old bag of bones, but I used to train in the spear, and I bet I can still remember a thing or two.

50120623.text: Let's get going. I'm gonna fight to the very end... just like they did.

50120624.text: Thanks again for your help. We'll be alright from here.

50120625.text: Okay, but be extra careful on your way back! We'll see you at the stadium!

50120702.text: Hey, wake up! And you, wake up!

50120704.text: Oh no... were we too late?

50120705.text: We were on our way to the stadium with our saurians, when that dark entity emerged in the sky. Seconds later, the Abyss monsters appeared and changed into saurian form.

50120706.text: They fought till the end to protect us... and now...

50120707.text: You should keep moving. This is no place to hang around.

50120708.text: Right, you need to get to the stadium. C'mon, we'll take you.

50120710.text: I'm so sorry, truly I am... May the Wayob watch over your souls, now and forever...

50120716.text: Y—Yeah... Paimon knows, it's just... it hasn't fully sunk in yet...

50120717.text: But anyway, right now, let's focus on getting them to the Stadium.

50120718.text: With any luck, there'll be an update waiting for us there. If not... we'll just have to play things by ear.

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the courier(s) at the Stadium

50121301.text: Need the latest battle report? We don't have too much information, since so few messengers are making it back here.

50121302.text: But as I understand, the folks at the Scions of the Canopy outpost suffered a large-scale Abyss attack as they were trying to evacuate civilians to the Stadium.

50121303.text: If you're free, please head there immediately.

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

50125001.text: Thanks for your help. We'll manage for now, please go help the other affected areas.

50125002.text: Nowhere's safe from the Abyss monsters now, but at least they're still scared off by the Sacred Flame. We'll stay here and protect any refugees who have come here to seek sanctuary.

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

50120801.text: Guess you're the sole survivor, huh buddy?

50120802.text: There there, don't be scared. Head to the Stadium, you'll be safe there. It's that way.

50120803.text: You're upset, and nothing Paimon says can make it better... But you have to go right away, okay?

50120806.text: Yeah, you're right. We have to keep going.

50120807.text: The latest intel said the Children of Echoes need support too. Let's head over.

50121001.text: Great, you made it here unscathed!

50121002.text: Kinich came by just now with some really bad news: Those indestructible Abyss things have been dropped by all of the tribal territories.

50121003.text: So it wasn't just the Children of Echoes. Even the Collective of Plenty was affected, and they're the furthest away.

50121004.text: But the worst-affected region was the Flower-Feather Clan's. He said it's a complete disaster over there...

50121005.text: What? Isn't that... Chasca's tribe? She said she was gonna take Chuychu home to rest for a while...

50121006.text: Kinich didn't even stop to catch his breath before leaving for the Stadium. He said he was gonna try and assemble a team to go and support them, but...

50121007.text: But how, right? Everyone's struggling just to defend themselves — there is no spare manpower. At this rate, it won't be long before even the Stadium is indefensible.

50121008.text: And with everyone congregating at the Stadium, the Abyss forces will start converging there, too... Then, there'll be a battle on a scale much larger than anything we've seen so far.

50121009.text: On the bright side, at least my old injuries aren't playing up at the moment. It means I can actually join in with the fighting.

50121010.text: The crux of the issue is that the heart of the Abyss itself has joined the invasion. That's a power we just can't match.

50121011.text: I have every faith in the courage of our people — the Natlanese will never give in to despair. But still... the fact is, our lives are more fragile than our spirits.

50121012.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon knows what you're about to say...

50121013.text: We have to go to the Flower-Feather Clan.

50121014.text: Yeah. Paimon sure is getting tired from all this flying, but... It doesn't matter! Wherever you go, Paimon's going too!

50121017.text: Yep. We'll leave the Children of Echoes to you guys. Flower-Feather Clan, hang in there, we're coming!

50121018.text: Really? But... you guys must be nearing your limit, surely!

50121019.text: If there was ever a time to push ourselves to the limit, that time is now!

50121102.text: The latest intel said the Children of Echoes need support too. Let's head over.

50121202.text: What happened to the other warriors?

50121203.text: After you left, some of them started evacuating the civilians, while the rest stayed behind to keep guard... but they're all dead. I'm the only survivor.

50121204.text: We're done for now. The Abyss will attack again any minute, and then I'll be a dead man too... The last few civilians holed up indoors won't stand a chance...

50121205.text: Hang in there, we'll think of something! There's gotta be a way out of this.

50121206.text: Like what? None of the civilians have any combat experience. There are old people, children, wounded... They can't defend themselves.

50121207.text: The monsters are gone for now, right?

50121208.text: Get back inside. It's too dangerous out here.

50121209.text: I know it's dangerous. That's why I came out.

50121212.text: Can you spare some equipment for us?

50121213.text: I've never been in a battle before, but I'm young, and I can hold a weapon. That's gotta count for something.

50121214.text: And I used to fight in the Pilgrimage when I was a younger man. Admittedly, I never made it very far...

50121215.text: But if you hand me a spear, I think the old muscle-memory will kick in.

50121216.text: There are others willing to join us as well. I persuaded them to fight. We can't let the blood spilled by our warrior brethren be in vain.

50121217.text: We can't watch on as our heroes lose heart. And we can't let them fight alone.

50121218.text: Hmm, we don't have much equipment left...

50121220.text: With a few extra fighters, we should just about be able to hold our own. It'll be a slow advance, but that's better than being stuck here.

50121221.text: Everyone who's fighting, be prepared to follow my orders to the letter.

50121224.text: Take our hot air balloon. You can use it to get to the stadium.

50121225.text: No need, you'll have other people to save. We're taking up arms so that you can focus on more important things. You're the heroes, after all.

50121226.text: Okay, well... Try going that way. That's the route we came from, and there weren't too many monsters.

50121227.text: Thank you both. You've been a huge help.

50121228.text: I am devastated by the deaths of my brothers-in-arms. But if their sacrifice means anything, I have to live on.

50121229.text: We're not going down without a fight.

50121231.text: Thanks, we will. Now, go. There are other people to save out there.

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

50125101.text: These monsters — they're what the winners of the Pilgrimage go on to fight, aren't they?

50125102.text: So that makes us veterans of the Night Warden Wars now, too.

50125103.text: I hadn't thought of it like that, but now that you mention it... Yeah. You're right.

50125104.text: Neither of us are name bearers, so in principle, we should never have had the chance to fight on the front lines. In that sense, this is... kind of a dream come true for us, isn't it?

50125105.text: We're not in this for fame, or glory, but for our childhood dreams of one day becoming a hero.

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Follow the voice to find the survivor(s)
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

50121402.text: It's a real shame I'm stuck here nursing my wounds, otherwise I'd be out there on the front line delivering the latest intel to you guys.

50121403.text: What's the current situation out there?

50121404.text: *sigh* Fewer and fewer messengers are making it back, and each trip seems to be taking longer than the last... It gives me a really bad feeling.

50121405.text: I'll update you on the latest intel for now. For next time though, I'll see if I can find someone to bring the updates directly to you.

50121406.text: I can't guarantee anything, though. As you know, we're seriously short on people.

50121409.text: Heh... I don't know how you do it. You really are a true hero.

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

50125201.text: There you go, buddy. It's still gonna hurt for a few days, but apart from that, you're on the up and up.

50125204.text: It IS you! Oh, thank goodness you're okay!

50125205.text: Toto was the only member of his family who didn't flee from the invasion. I don't know if he was being territorial or what, but he stayed and fought the Abyss...

50125206.text: If you hadn't gotten here when you did, he may not have made it.

50125207.text: We should let him rest here until he's able to stand again. I'll look after him.

50125208.text: Thank you so much! Toto, next time you're told to evacuate, be a good saurian and do as you're told, okay? Otherwise, Kachina will be worried sick about you.

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Defeat the monsters and destroy the Abyssal Pylon
Talk to the warriors stationed here

50120901.text: This is the second time you've had to come to our rescue... I'm a little ashamed.

50120902.text: Thanks to your efforts last time, we managed to fend off the Abyss here even after whatever that was appeared in the sky.

50120903.text: But at this point... I think we're going to have to cut our losses. This base is as good as gone.

50120904.text: Yeah. Everyone needs to stick together. Best to regroup somewhere else.

50120905.text: Alright, time to evacuate. There's a volunteer unit here too, so first I need to ask them what they want to do next.

50120906.text: For anyone who still wants to fight on the frontlines, the Children of Echoes' front is the closest to here. Anyone who wants to leave will likely also see action as they evacuate, but will be afforded safety at the Stadium.

50120907.text: Those are the options. We're abandoning this base, and you're free to stay with the group or leave.

50120908.text: As of this moment, the Children of Echoes are reasonably well-defended. So please, weigh the risks and consider your families' safety before you make a decision.

50120909.text: Now then. Anyone who wishes to keep fighting, show me how serious you are.

50120911.text: But if Natlan is destroyed, will there still be a home for us to return to?

50120912.text: If anyone wants a future, it's on them to go out there and grab it. Period. No one wants to be that person who sat back and hoped for the best while other people were giving their blood for our nation.

50120916.text: You heard them. This means we'll all be going to support the Children of Echoes garrison.

50120917.text: Great. Well, you all seem in good spirits, so that's encouraging. But still, please be careful!

50120918.text: Don't worry, it'll be just like another Night Warden War. We'll force the Abyss back if it's the last thing we do.

50120921.text: Shoot, that creepy Abyss thing is raining down a dangerous-looking substance again!

50120922.text: ...That's over towards People of the Springs territory. From what I've heard, their defenses have been substantially weakened by the Abyss invasion.

50120923.text: Then let's head over and check on them!

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat the monsters and destroy the Abyssal Pylon
Talk to the warriors stationed here

50122101.text: Thank you so much, you saved the day. The enemy attacks grow stronger with each wave... We're nearly at breaking point.

50122102.text: Given how few of us are left, I think it's time we cut our losses. This base is as good as gone.

50122103.text: Yeah. Everyone needs to stick together. Best to regroup somewhere else.

50122104.text: ...Better late than never. Time to evacuate. Warriors, gather 'round!

50122105.text: For anyone who still wants to fight on the frontlines, the Children of Echoes' front is the closest to here. Anyone who wants to leave will likely also see action as they evacuate, but will be afforded safety at the Stadium.

50122106.text: Those are the options. We're abandoning this base, and you're free to stay with the group or leave.

50122107.text: With our limited numbers, I can't promise that we'll be of any real assistance to the Children of Echoes' war effort, even if we do join them. Please bear this in mind as you make your decision.

50122108.text: Now then. Anyone who wishes to keep fighting, show me how serious you are.

50122110.text: Why would we give up now, after everything we've been through? We didn't stick it out this far just to admit defeat.

50122111.text: We can't give another inch to the Abyss. We have to fight them back — if not for our own sake, then at least for our fallen brethren.

50122115.text: We may be few in number, but our will remains strong. We will join the ranks of the Children of Echoes and they will be stronger for it, however little.

50122116.text: Okay... Well, take care of yourselves.

50122117.text: Don't worry, it'll be just like another Night Warden War. We'll force the Abyss back if it's the last thing we do.

50122120.text: Shoot, that creepy Abyss thing is raining down a dangerous-looking substance again!

50122121.text: ...That's over towards People of the Springs territory. From what I've heard, their defenses have been substantially weakened by the Abyss invasion.

50122122.text: Then let's head over and check on them!

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce

50125301.text: May the Wayob grant you peace, and may songs be sung of your life's journey.

50125302.text: We give thanks for the gift of your life in ours. And we look forward to meeting you again one day, in a world of wonder and beauty.

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Track the Abyssal contamination down to where it fell
Search for survivors or any information of value

50122401.text: There's just one battle report left, and it gives a long list of places where the "dangerous substance" has been dropping.

50122402.text: *sigh* This is the first report we've had in ages, which means the messengers' job has become all but impossible...

50122403.text: But there's nothing we can do about that. Our priority is to get to the next affected zone.

50122404.text: Even if we don't find any survivors, maybe... maybe that strange substance over there won't be as rock-solid as here? There's a chance, at least?

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Ride the hot air balloon to reinforce the hotspot
Ride the hot air balloon to reinforce the hotspot
Speak to the people in the area

50123001.text: Move out! You've gotta get out of here!

50123002.text: Still no luck, huh. What on earth are these things? How are they invulnerable to attack?

50123003.text: Yeah, at least with regular Abyssal Pylons, anyone with a Vision can destroy them. But this thing? No one's seen anything like it before.

50123004.text: It's like... a part of that sky-demon's body, or something...

50123005.text: Whatever it is, it seems like it can spawn Abyssal Pylons — and with them, a never-ending stream of Abyss monsters. We're just no match for it.

50123006.text: At this point, retreat looks like our best option. We're fighting a losing battle here.

50123007.text: The Stadium is our only hope. That's where the sacred flame is, which seems to be the one thing that well of Abyssal energy is afraid of.

50123008.text: The Pyro Archon is guarding the flame. As long as that continues, we still have hope.

50123010.text: Water, and some snacks — you look like you need it. I'm guessing you've been supporting the fight all over the map? Sounds like you need a breather.

50123011.text: We've got enough people to hold our own here, and it's high time you took a break. Why don't you sit down and gather your strength for a minute?

50123012.text: #It's true, we've been fighting pretty much non-stop. {NICKNAME}, you must be exhausted, what do you think?

50123013.text: Right now, there are bigger things to worry about.

50123017.text: Oh, you're right. Well then, guess we'd better go warn them...

50123018.text: Um... It's your decision, if you wanna set off right away, Paimon will come with you!

subQuests.subQuestName: Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Check the map and select a hotspot to reinforce
Head to the Children of Echoes's camp

50123101.text: Ah, it's you guys. Things are bad here — something fell out the sky that's impervious to our attacks.

50123102.text: Not just here. We've run into a few of these already.

50123103.text: Pacal gave the order for everyone to evacuate. Xilonen and I stayed behind as the rearguard.

50123104.text: It's a good thing you did... otherwise, we might not have made it in time.

50123105.text: #Kachina, {M#he}{F#she} and I can deal with the remaining monsters and Abyssal Pylons. You should go catch up with the rest of the group before your parents start worrying about you.

50123106.text: Got it. I'll leave right away — they need all the help they can get.

50123108.text: Come on. Let's get this done.

subQuests.subQuestName: Evac complete, prepare to fall back

50123301.text: Yep, that's everyone, and no more casualties by the looks of things... This is good. We can evacuate shortly.

50123302.text: I appreciate your help. How are things out there? Pretty dire, I bet.

50123304.text: Some of the things I've seen, I don't know if I'll ever be able to get them out of my mind... Are we in Natlan doomed to this fate?

50123305.text: I've never witnessed a full-scale Abyss invasion before. I mean, I'd heard stories about the sky being painted black, but I always thought that was an exaggeration.

50123306.text: Mavuika has witnessed this all before, so she knew better than anyone the terror and despair an Abyss invasion would bring.

50123307.text: Yeah... and despite that, she's still facing it head on...

50123308.text: We've had to abandon our homes and chase the dying light of day. Maybe the only time we'll see the dawn again is in our dreams.

50123309.text: But as long as there's even a sliver of hope, I'm not gonna give up.

50123311.text: We should catch up with the group. Let's go.

subQuests.subQuestName: Rendezvous with the team that evacuated first
Defeat the monsters surrounding Chasca and Chuychu

50123602.text: Wh—What happened to her? She's covered in Abyssal energy!

50123605.text: How's that, Chuychu? Any better now?

50123607.text: Chasca... I used to think mom and dad were crazy for adopting you...

50123608.text: I was the younger sibling, but I always felt like it was my job to help mom and dad take care of you... I thought I could set you free from the Abyssal energy you struggled with...

50123609.text: I... guess I was pretty full of myself, huh? Thinking I could fix you, when... Well, we were always the same...

50123610.text: Hush, Chuychu, put those thoughts right out of your mind. We'll be at the stadium in no time, okay? I'll carry you there.

50123611.text: The Abyssal contamination is gone now. Just rest, and you'll get better.

50123612.text: I was always nagging you to slow down, stop rushing headlong into things...

50123613.text: I just didn't want anything to happen to you, or to anyone else because of you...

50123614.text: I worried about you so much. But now, I realize... I never really understood what it's like for you.

50123615.text: The fact that you survived an Abyssal contamination was a miracle, but it also left you in a constant state of agitation...

50123616.text: The fact that we became family was another miracle. But with me worrying about you all the time, it feels like I just agitated you even further.

50123617.text: No, absolutely not. Nothing could be further from the truth, do you hear me?

50123618.text: All you ever did was love me, same goes for mom and dad. I've always known that, and I feel terrible, because I really did want to get along as a family.

50123619.text: It might take me some time, but I'll find a way to make it work. I'm so sorry, Chuychu, I never meant to make you feel this way...

50123620.text: It's okay, Chasca. No need to apologize. You didn't do anything wrong — no one did. It's nobody's fault that things didn't turn out great.

50123621.text: I get it now. So, no nagging from me this time.

50123623.text: Never slow down, and never hold back. Spread your wings and fly free, like the fiercest qucusaur in the sky. Show the world who the bravest Flower-Feather warrior is...

50123624.text: Because that's who you are... and that's the sister I'm proud of.

50123635.text: What was that just now? It looked like Abyssal energy was flowing out of her, but then a split-second later, it disappeared...

50123636.text: Chasca managed to rein it in.

50123637.text: Chuychu did say that Chasca needs to let off steam now and then, or she'll end up losing herself. But this time, she wrestled back control.

50123639.text: If only we were faster... Dealing with Abyssal contamination is a piece of cake for you.

50123640.text: We could've gotten to her earlier, then you could've treated her before... before it was too...

50123642.text: How unfair life can be... She's had the odds stacked against her from the very beginning, and each step forward has been an agonizing one. Maybe she would have been better off embracing her pain...

50123643.text: But her journey goes on, and one question looms large in her mind: If she could rise above the layers of pain, and ascend over the dark clouds of her mind... what, then, would she find?

50123644.text: Maybe the glorious light of the sun, or maybe a dark, empty void. There is only one way to find out. She needs to spread her wings and soar to new heights... that is the true meaning of life.

50123646.text: "My life's suffering shall be my epitaph."

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring Chuychu back to the Stadium with Chasca

50123701.text: Please, take care of Chuychu for me...

50123702.text: I still have more important things to do.

50123703.text: Of course. We are grateful for her service.

50123706.text: It's alright. I'm far from the only one going through this right now.

50123707.text: Chuychu wanted to be a hero, and in my heart, she always will be.

50123708.text: If we want to honor what she stood for, not to mention her sacrifice... Archon, we need to hurry.

50123710.text: Time for this war to end.

subQuests.subQuestName: Head to the center of the Stadium to witness the gathering of heroes

50123801.text: That is an outright scary level of power...

50123802.text: So from now on, all warriors will be able to resurrect themselves using the sacred flame...

50123804.text: It's time to wipe the enemy off the face of the earth.

50123805.text: And to reclaim our lost territory.

50123806.text: This is for all those who gave their lives for Natlan.

50123810.text: I'm so grateful you got to us when you did. You gave Chuychu the chance to say those words to me before the end...

50123811.text: If I'd lost control out there in the wild... This counter-attack might never have been possible.

50123812.text: Probably best not to think about that. More importantly... how are you feeling now? Any better?

50123813.text: Not really, but now's not the time to deal with it. In the spirit of Vu{RUBY#[D]Transcension}ka, I have to rise above it.

50123814.text: The conflict and suffering in me are there to test my character. My struggle will make me stronger...

50123815.text: ...And make me the person Chuychu believed I can be.

50123817.text: Alright, let's go show the Abyss what human beings are made of! They'll be sorry they messed with Natlan after we're through with them!

412200303.text: I'm here for my Box o' Marvels.

412200302.text: The items needed today are as such.

412200403.text: I'm here for my Box o' Marvels.

412200402.text: I reckon you've already collected one for the day, friend! Still, feel free to inspect the other boxes. As before, you'll find that I'm no cheat.

412200543.text: Can you run me through your background again?

412200544.text: I'm Liben, and once upon a time, I sold curios.

412200545.text: I'm working hard these days to save up for a nice long vacation.

412200546.text: What kind of business are you talking about?

412200547.text: Simple. You find me a few basic everyday items, cooking ingredients and the like, and then you trade them with me for a Box o' Marvels, full of all kinds of nice little treasures.

412200548.text: Keep in mind that I've filled these Boxes o' Marvels with the fortune I made in my time as a seller of curios. There's no booby prizes to be found here, and I treat all my customers the same.

412200549.text: Why box them up and turn it into a lucky draw, you ask?

412200550.text: What can I say, people like a gift box. It just makes everyone a little more inclined to get involved.

412200551.text: How do you earn any money like this?

412200552.text: They say that everyone in Snezhnaya is tightening their belts, so there should be a business opportunity there or two.

412200756.text: Ah, friend, we meet once more.

412200757.text: Liben, where have you been raking in all that wealth lately?

412200758.text: Heh, I'm not exactly rolling in it like you think. Honestly, I might've even lost a few Mora.

412200759.text: I was recently doing business at the Collective of Plenty. Someone took a look at my mushrooms and said:

412200760.text: "Hmm... They look rather... ordinary. Not like those of the mushroom god's."

412200761.text: What in the world is a "mushroom god"? And is there some new variety of edible mushroom I should've known about?

412200762.text: But I have to get home for the Lantern Rite whether there's money in my pocket or not. So, I've been running shorter trade routes recently — Dornman Port, for example.

412200765.text: It's just north of Mondstadt. Have you not been there before, friend?

412200766.text: Well, someone was holding me back, telling me we'll "explore it later."

412200767.text: It's a port town built on cargo shipping and flower cultivation. Just looking at it makes you feel at ease.

412200768.text: There used to be a very famous sanatorium up in the hills there, but it was torn down a few years ago.

412200769.text: Speaking of which, it's actually kind of creepy. There's a pretty chilling saying about that sanatorium up in the hills...

412200770.text: They say that "anyone who visits the sanatorium will remain in those enchanted hills forever more."

412200771.text: Because the place is so comfortable that there's no reason to leave...?

412200772.text: I guess it's not so creepy if you look at it that way. Maybe that saying started because of the fresh air up there, far from all the dust and noise below.

412200773.text: Hmm, it must be nice to live in the hills.

412200774.text: There are plenty of beautiful mountains and other scenic spots in Liyue too.

412200775.text: That's very true. But, alone in the mountains, you can't help but worry about things like getting food and water or the risk of being dragged off by wild animals. Especially since no one's really set up the kinds of services needed for a proper retreat yet.

412200776.text: It really has to be a proper retreat: pay to stay, get a nice rest, enjoy the opportunity to be close to nature. That's the only way one can feel truly comfortable.

412200777.text: In any case, I'd better get busy since staying at a sanatorium costs money. Looks like it's business as usual for us, then?

50126501.text: Best of luck. I hope to hear good news.

50129801.text: You and Chasca take Chuychu back to the Stadium.

50129905.text: Yet another place crawling with monsters...

50129906.text: Let's clear the area and see if there are any survivors.

50129907.text: Monsters everywhere you look, and... Oh no, looks like there's a saurian corpse...

50129908.text: Doesn't look like we'll be able to find anyone here... The monsters are all that's left.

50129911.text: These warriors are struggling! Quick, let's help them!

50129912.text: What the... Paimon can't believe it...

50129913.text: Oh, thank goodness! Those people are still standing!

50129915.text: Wait, over there! It's Chasca and Chuychu...

50129917.text: There are too many monsters... There are just too many, it's beyond anything we've seen before...
